# truenas_keychain_ssh_keypair (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS keychain SSH key pair credential (keychaincredential.* with type=SSH_KEY_PAIR) by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the keychain credential to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the keychain credential.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) SSH private key in OpenSSH PEM format.
- `public_key` (String) SSH public key in OpenSSH authorized_keys format.
